body.purpose: 16px/1.75 reading content. Self-hosted Noto Sans SC Variable from @fontsource-variable/noto-sans-sc 5.3.1; PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, system-ui, sans-serif fallbacks. Bundled unicode-range subsets work offline with font-display: swap. Weights: 400 regular, 500 medium, 600 semibold.

ui.purpose: 14px/1.45 controls and inherited workspace text; inspector tabs and shortcut help remain 14px.

meta.purpose: 13px lifecycle status, save feedback, counts, history metadata, and dock labels. Tabular numerals for counts and zoom.

small.purpose: 12px small text, keyboard hints, code baseline, graph metadata, and node footer. Reader code blocks explicitly use 13px; inline code remains relative to surrounding text.

title.purpose: 20px/1.4 workspace heading, 600 weight, zero tracking; 18px on mobile. Brand wordmark remains 20px.

headline.purpose: 22px/1.5, 600 weight, zero tracking for full node and graph reader headings.

node-title.purpose: 16px/22px, 600 weight at reading scale. Below .65 zoom: balanced two-line clamp(24px, 14px / zoom, 34px). Geometry stays 248×116.

node-summary.purpose: 12px/16px optional two-line summary; 2px top margin. Hidden in overview with the 12px footer. Edge labels use 12px/18px, rising to clamp(18px, 12px / zoom, 30px) in overview.

reading.purpose: 16px/1.75 Markdown explanations outside the compact graph card; reader summaries use 1.8 leading. Read-first graph/node behavior remains in the application, not in these static examples.

label.purpose: 14px, 500 weight; explanatory field metadata is 13px, 400 weight.

button.purpose: 14px, 500 weight for primary, secondary, and subtle controls. Mobile toolbar scope/read labels use 13px; at ≤350px the toolbar may wrap to two rows rather than shrink text further.

notes.purpose: 14px/1.75 in the interface font, not monospace; mobile inspector fields use 16px. Code, IDs and keyboard hints use SFMono-Regular, Consolas, Liberation Mono, Noto Sans SC Variable, monospace. exportFontCSS in frontend/src/fontEmbedding.ts waits for mounted export text and embeds only loaded interface-font subsets; exports keep their separate compact typography.

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Floating node dock, zoom controls, and busy message; tokens.css. The flush 56px-minimum top toolbar has no shadow.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Inspector, dialog, and mobile drawer; tokens.css.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Background, border, color, shadow, and edge-stroke state changes; styles.css.

motion.name: panel-content-settle
motion.purpose: Inspector enters from 10px horizontally; reader identity changes enter from 6px vertically at .72 opacity. No typing/revision-triggered remounts; App.tsx and ui/Motion.tsx.

motion.name: dialog-settle
motion.purpose: Dialog enters from 10px vertically at .985 scale; 160ms backdrop tint. Immediate removal preserves existing focus/lifecycle behavior; Dialog.tsx.

motion.name: drawer-transition
motion.purpose: Mobile navigation transform, with delayed visibility on close and immediate inert; styles.css.

motion.name: dock-selection-spring
motion.purpose: Shared task/tab selection and icons-only dock proximity. Dock scale 1–1.22, lift 0–4px; fixed hit areas. Disabled for narrow/coarse-pointer/reduced-motion states; ui/Motion.tsx and ui/reactbits/NodeDock.tsx.

motion.name: scope-thumb
motion.purpose: Controlled, non-draggable React Bits RubberSegment adaptation; separate clipped edges with native button activation and keyboard navigation; ui/reactbits/FlowScope.tsx.

motion.name: aurora-atmosphere
motion.purpose: Canvas-only native-WebGL2 React Bits adaptation. OKLCH palette #829de2/#81cbbb/#9daceb; DPR ≤1, buffer width ≤1280px. Persistent pause toggle; no RAF during interaction/editing/hidden states. No canvas for mobile/coarse/reduced-motion/user-disabled modes; CSS fallback on context failure; ui/reactbits/Aurora.tsx.

motion.name: spotlight-material
motion.purpose: Local radial falloff and masked rim on dock and empty state, pointer-transparent, no idle loop; ui/reactbits/SpotlightCard.tsx and atmosphere.css.

motion.name: primary-sheen
motion.purpose: Native approval/empty-state button, hover/focus only, no idle loop, disabled under reduced motion; ui/reactbits/GlareHover.tsx and atmosphere.css.

motion.name: canvas-reading-fit
motion.purpose: Explicit reading and fit commands; App.tsx. Initial task/version fit is immediate. Canvas resizing preserves zoom and the centered graph point by adjusting x/y by half the size delta, without refitting.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Subscribed media-query preference (not Motion 14's initial-only hook): static indicators/dock, direct scope jumps, instant panel/dialog/viewport updates and CSS cancellation of in-flight entrances. UI smoke verifies launch-time preference via Chromium flag and live preference changes through a test-only CDP media bridge.

narrative.overview:
Pale-gray navigation with a right separator sits beside a cool-white working document. Blue connects selection, focus, and primary actions; restrained executor and lifecycle colors help readers distinguish meaning without tinting entire cards. Conventional controls and compact chrome leave room for the graph and its full explanations.

This is a code-led record of typography and icon polish, not a shipping verdict. Primary authority: frontend/src/tokens.css, styles.css, icons.ts, and App.tsx; related behavior remains in FlowNode.tsx, GraphInspector.tsx, NodeInspector.tsx, Dialog.tsx, fontEmbedding.ts, and exportLayout.ts. Product and direction remain in PRODUCT.md and .impeccable/surfaces/frontend.md. Current review artifacts belong in .impeccable/review/type-icons/; prior atmosphere/motion/refinement/polish images and earlier captures directly under .impeccable/review/ are historical. Actual-render review remains separate; this documentation asserts neither test results nor scope-wide shipping readiness.

Self-hosted @fontsource-variable/noto-sans-sc 5.3.1 supplies Noto Sans SC Variable via bundled unicode-range subsets, with font-display: swap and PingFang SC / Microsoft YaHei / system-ui fallbacks. No remote font service is required. exportFontCSS embeds loaded interface-font subsets after mounting export content; it does not load every shard. exportLayout.ts preserves live balanced note-column membership as independent grid columns so SVG height copying cannot force notes beyond the image edge. UI_ICON_STYLE supplies one Phosphor bold default; the routed-F brand mark remains separate. Reader and short-height dialog functions are described from source, not claimed as verified. Existing motion, atmospheric effects, graph geometry, lifecycle protections and viewport behavior remain intact.

The fake workspace card, local-file footer, decorative header breadcrumbs, “图先行再实现”, default footer instruction, and repeated approval authorization copy remain removed. Lifecycle, save, and error feedback remain; authorization details appear only in the confirmation dialog. Graph-reader tutorial and artifact promotional copy remain removed; quality warnings, full PNG export, and historical JSON/text/PNG downloads remain.
keyCharacteristics: Pale-gray navigation, white document surfaces, pale dotted canvas.
Blue selection and action; labeled, restrained state colors.
14px interface controls, 13px metadata, and a separate 16px/1.75 full-text reading path.
Bundled Noto Sans SC Variable, Phosphor bold role-sized icons, and a routed-F brand mark; no remote assets.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Color Rule
rules.body: Pair executor and lifecycle colors with text or icons; reserve blue for focus, selection, navigation, and actions rather than executor identity.

rules.name: The Overview Is Not Reading Rule
rules.body: Below 65% zoom, adaptive node titles prioritize structure; use “100% 阅读” or the inspector for full text.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Use elevation to distinguish cards, floating tools, overlays, and dialogs; retain the thin separators between persistent document regions.

dos: Do keep blue selection distinct from executor and lifecycle color.
Do preserve shared node geometry and provide 100% reading plus full inspector text.
Do keep save and lifecycle state visible on narrow screens; keep authorization details in the confirmation dialog.
Do retain keyboard focus, reduced-motion handling, bundled offline fonts, and consistent bold icon roles.
donts: Don't restore the rejected navy navigation, repetitive instructional chrome, or executor-tinted cards.
Don't treat fit-to-canvas text as the reading experience or reuse tiny metadata sizes for body copy.
Don't load remote fonts, CDN assets, or external imagery for this workspace.
Don't infer a passed design review or test run from this documentation.
